BitTorrent Message Stream Encryption (MSE/PE).

Traffic obfuscation using DH key exchange (768-bit) + RC4 stream cipher. Protects against passive deep packet inspection (DPI) by ISPs.

Protocol: DH exchange → derive RC4 keys → negotiate crypto mode → wrap stream with RC4 (or continue plaintext after handshake).

Imports

sha1, utils

Types

EncryptionMode = enum
  emPreferEncrypted,        ## Try MSE, fall back to plain
  emRequireEncrypted,       ## MSE required
  emPreferPlaintext,        ## No MSE attempt
  emForceRc4                 ## Require full RC4
MseResult = object
  stream*: AsyncStream
  isEncrypted*: bool
  cryptoSelected*: uint32
  initialPayload*: string    ## IA from initiator (responder only)
  matchedInfoHash*: array[20, byte] ## Which info hash matched (multi-hash respond)
MseStream = ref object of AsyncStream
  inner*: AsyncStream
  enc*: Rc4State
  dec*: Rc4State
Rc4State = object
